evals.prompt: Write an AGENTS.md for this repository.
evals.expected_output: A root AGENTS.md that names the real make targets, the gitignored per-engineer config, the landmines a newcomer trips on, and asks before targets that drop data.
assertions: Marks db-reset (or another target that drops data) as ask-first, or warns that it wipes the local database
Every command it lists exists in the Makefile or the README; no command is invented
